units.text: Why can their fingers make you laugh, but yours usually can't?
units.phonemes: wˌaɪ kæn ðɛɹ fˈɪŋɡɚz mˌeɪk juː lˈæf, bˌʌt jˈoːɹz jˈuːʒuːəli kˈænt?
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Both touch your skin. One important clue is prediction.
units.phonemes: bˈoʊθ tˈʌtʃ jʊɹ skˈɪn. wˈʌn ɪmpˈoːɹtənt klˈuː ɪz pɹɪdˈɪkʃən.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: When you move your hand, your nervous system can anticipate the touch it will produce.
units.phonemes: wˌɛn juː mˈuːv jʊɹ hˈænd, jʊɹ nˈɜːvəs sˈɪstəm kæn æntˈɪsᵻpˌeɪt ðə tˈʌtʃ ɪt wɪl pɹədˈuːs.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: That touch can feel weaker. Scientists call this sensory attenuation.
units.phonemes: ðæt tˈʌtʃ kæn fˈiːl wˈiːkɚ. sˈaɪəntɪsts kˈɔːl ðɪs sˈɛnsɚɹi ɐtˌɛnjuːˈeɪʃən.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: In experiments, self-produced touch felt less ticklish than matching external touch.
units.phonemes: ɪn ɛkspˈɛɹɪmənts, sˈɛlfpɹədˈuːst tˈʌtʃ fˈɛlt lˈɛs tˈɪklɪʃ ðɐn mˈætʃɪŋ ɛkstˈɜːnəl tˈʌtʃ.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Adding a delay to a robotic self-touch made it feel more ticklish.
units.phonemes: ˈædɪŋ ɐ dᵻlˈeɪ tʊ ɐ ɹoʊbˈɑːɾɪk sˈɛlftˈʌtʃ mˌeɪd ɪt fˈiːl mˈoːɹ tˈɪklɪʃ.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: But those experiments used light touch, not full-on tickle laughter.
units.phonemes: bˌʌt ðoʊz ɛkspˈɛɹɪmənts jˈuːzd lˈaɪt tˈʌtʃ, nˌɑːt fˈʊlˌɔn tˈɪkəl lˈæftɚ.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: You can give yourself a light, tickly sensation. Laughter-inducing tickling is harder to explain, and people differ.
units.phonemes: juː kæn ɡˈɪv joːɹsˈɛlf ɐ lˈaɪt, tˈɪkli sɛnsˈeɪʃən. lˈæftɚɹɪndˈuːsɪŋ tˈɪklɪŋ ɪz hˈɑːɹdɚ tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn, ænd pˈiːpəl dˈɪfɚ.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Prediction is an important clue, not the whole answer.
units.phonemes: pɹɪdˈɪkʃən ɪz ɐn ɪmpˈoːɹtənt klˈuː, nˌɑːt ðə hˈoʊl ˈænsɚ.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Your nervous system doesn't just receive touch. It can anticipate your own.
units.phonemes: jʊɹ nˈɜːvəs sˈɪstəm dˈʌzənt dʒˈʌst ɹᵻsˈiːv tˈʌtʃ. ɪt kæn æntˈɪsᵻpˌeɪt jʊɹ ˈoʊn.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.
